intro: Connectors to organise a longer opinion: start, add, contrast and close.
p.en primer lugar.consejo: It opens a series of ideas. Then you can continue with «en segundo lugar» or «además».
p.además.consejo: It adds an idea in the same direction. It usually starts a sentence, with a comma: «Además, es barato».
p.por un lado.consejo: It almost always goes with «por otro lado»: «por un lado… por otro lado…».
p.por otro lado.consejo: It presents the other side of the same thing. Sometimes it contrasts and sometimes it adds.
p.sin embargo.consejo: It marks a contrast with what came before. It is two words, followed by a comma.
p.en cambio.consejo: It compares two different things or people: «él lee; ella, en cambio, escribe».
p.por eso.consejo: It gives the result of what you have just said. It is written as two words.
p.en resumen.consejo: It closes a text with the main idea. It is similar to «en conclusión».
p.creo que.consejo: It gives your opinion. When you affirm, the next verb is indicative: «creo que es buena idea».
p.en mi opinión.consejo: It is used to give your point of view. It starts the sentence, followed by a comma.
p.ciudad.consejo: It ends in -dad and is feminine: «la ciudad». The final d sounds very soft.
p.centro.consejo: The c sounds th in Spain: THEN-tro. «El centro» is the middle area of the city.
b1.texto:
Connectors organise a long opinion:

- **Start:** en primer lugar, creo que, en mi opinión
- **Add:** además
- **Two sides:** por un lado… por otro lado
- **Contrast:** sin embargo, en cambio
- **Result:** por eso
- **Close:** en resumen

Almost all of them go at the **start** of the sentence, followed by a **comma**. They do not change the verb form.
b2.f0.texto: In my opinion, living in the city is a good idea.
b2.f1.texto: On the one hand, there is a lot of life in the centre.
b2.f2.texto: Besides, public transport is very good.
b2.f3.texto: However, the flats in the centre are very expensive.
b2.f4.texto: On the other hand, life in a village is calmer.
b2.f5.texto: My sister, on the other hand, prefers the noise of the city.
b2.f6.texto: That is why I think choosing is not easy.
b2.f7.texto: In short, the best thing is to try both places.
b4.texto:
The connector goes at the **start** of the sentence, followed by a **comma**:

- **Además**, el café es barato. (adds an idea)
- Me gusta la ciudad. **Sin embargo**, es cara. (contrast)
- A Pablo le gusta el tren. **En cambio**, Lucía prefiere el autobús. (compares two people)
- Vive lejos. **Por eso** llega tarde. (result)

**Por un lado** presents one side of the matter and **por otro lado** the next. **En resumen** closes the text.
b4.e0.texto: Besides, the coffee in this city is cheap.
b4.e1.texto: However, the city is very expensive.
b4.e2.texto: In short, I like living here very much.
b5.f0.texto: The city wakes up with a buzz of engines and metal shutters.
b5.f1.texto: In the centre, the cafés put their tables out on the pavement under a still pink sky.
b5.f2.texto: The trams go by full of people in a hurry.
b5.f3.texto: However, amid so much noise, Lucía finds a quiet bench under a tree.
b5.f4.texto: There she sits down, closes her eyes and listens to how the city breathes.
b5.f5.texto: In contrast, her grandmother's village wakes up to the crowing of the roosters.
b5.f6.texto: The air smells of wet grass and wood smoke.
b5.f7.texto: The streets are narrow and full of sleeping cats.
b5.f8.texto: That is why Lucía walks more slowly and looks at every door with curiosity.
b5.f9.texto: In short, each place keeps a different music that she listens to attentively.
b6.o0.refuerzo: Yes! «Por eso» gives the consequence of what came before.
b6.o1.refuerzo: «Sin embargo» introduces a contrast, not a result.
b6.o2.refuerzo: «Además» adds another idea; it does not give a result.
b7.frase: Me gusta la ciudad. ____, es cara.
b7.o0.refuerzo: «Por eso» would give a result: «es cara, por eso no vivo allí».
b7.o1.refuerzo: Well done! It introduces an idea that goes against the first one.
b7.o2.refuerzo: «Además» would add something good, and expensive is not.
b7.pregunta: The second sentence contradicts the first. Which connector?
b8.frase: Vive lejos y por eso llega tarde
b8.traduccion: He lives far away and that is why he arrives late
b9.frase: A Pablo le gusta el tren. ____, Lucía prefiere el autobús.
b9.o0.refuerzo: «Por eso» would give a result, and here there is a comparison.
b9.o1.refuerzo: «En resumen» closes a text; we have not finished yet.
b9.o2.refuerzo: That is it! It compares what each person prefers.
b9.pregunta: Two different people are compared. Which connector?
b10.o0.refuerzo: «En primer lugar» opens a series; it does not close it.
b10.o1.refuerzo: Yes! «En resumen» gathers the main idea at the end.
b10.o2.refuerzo: «Además» keeps adding ideas; it does not close.
b10.pregunta: Which connector do you use to close a text?
b12.o0.refuerzo: «Por eso» gives a result and does not present the other side.
b12.o1.refuerzo: «En resumen» closes; the other side is still missing.
b12.o2.refuerzo: That is it! It forms a pair with «por un lado».
b12.pregunta: You start with «por un lado». What comes next?
p.transporte.consejo: Public transport means buses, trains and trams. Stress on «POR».
p.elegir.consejo: Infinitive of «elegir». The «g» before «i» sounds like «h».
p.motores.consejo: Plural of «motor». The stress falls on «TO».
p.acera.consejo: The «c» before «e» sounds like «th» in Spain.
p.tranvías.consejo: Plural of «tranvía». The accent on «í» separates the vowels: «tran-BI-as».
p.gallos.consejo: Plural of «gallo». The «ll» sounds like «y» in Spain.
p.leña.consejo: Wood for a fire. The «ñ» sounds like «ny».
p.sitios.consejo: Plural of «sitio», place. In Spain «ti» before a vowel sounds like «thy».
